title: hymenophyllum ferrugineum subsp. berteroi
intro: Hymenophyllum ferrugineum subsp. berteroi, commonly known as the Bertero's rusty fern, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is a type of vascular plant characterized by its fronds and ability to photosynthesize. The health benefits of Hymenophyllum ferrugineum subsp. berteroi include its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
